messages.content:
A person wrote this in the Slack thread of an incident Argus is responding to:

what has Argus done about this so far?

Call submit_meaning with what they meant.

tools.description: Submit what the person meant by their message about an incident. Choose exactly one meaning.

meaning.description: `resolve` if they say the incident is over - they ended it, or saw it end. `question` if they ask something about it. `information` if they tell you something about it you may not know. `withdraw` if they tell you to stop, stand down or cancel, and leave the incident to them - they are taking it over. `other` for anything else: thanks, a reaction, people talking to each other. A message saying it is not over, or asking whether it is, is not `resolve`; a message saying it is over is `resolve`, even if it also tells you to stop.

tools.name: submit_meaning
